CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and an origin/organization status is given for the same referent/time, meeting C,O,D bindings.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition was linked to content presentation/access.

D.rationale: Content is listed (red) and separately attributed an origin/status (history_estimate) for the same referent/time.
